title: Ferulic acid photoconversion maintains Nrf2-mediated antioxidant defense against UVA damage.
authors: Vikram, Apeksha; Patel, Sunil Kumar; Pathania, Diksha; Srivastava, Nupur; Rai, Abhishek Kumar; Ratnasekhar, C H; Singh, Sandeep; Ray, Ratan Singh; Dwivedi, Ashish
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究阿魏酸光转化维持Nrf2抗氧化防御以对抗UVA损伤，虽含Keap1对接但核心是细胞抗氧化与光保护，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic UVA exposure induces oxidative stress, DNA damage, and ultimately photoaging. Although natural antioxidants are considered safer than synthetic UV filters, many suffer from poor photostability and can even shift toward pro-oxidant activity upon UV irradiation. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the photostability and photoprotective efficacy of ferulic acid (FA) and determine whether its photoconversion retains protective activity. METHODS: FA photoconversion was analysed by UV-Vis and LC-QTOF-MS. Photoprotective effects were assessed in UVA-exposed HaCaT cells using ROS assays, mitochondrial function, DNA damage markers, RT-PCR, and in-silico docking of FA with Keap1. RESULTS: Upon UVA exposure, FA converted into caffeic acid (CA), yet both preserved antioxidant potential. FA reduces ROS, stabilizes mitochondria, minimizes DNA lesions, and maintaines normal cell cycle progression. Molecular analysis confirmed docking predicted activation of the Nrf2-Keap1 antioxidant pathway and suppression of oxidative, inflammatory, and apoptotic markers. Notably, FA photoproduct showed no pro-oxidant behaviour and retained its antioxidant activity. CONCLUSION: This study demonstrates a unique photoconversion-driven stability, where FA transforms into CA without loss of efficacy. By combining ROS scavenging and Nrf2-mediated gene regulation, FA represents a promising, safe bioactive agent for broad-spectrum sun-care formulations.
abstract_zh: 背景：长期UVA暴露会诱导氧化应激、DNA损伤，并最终导致光老化。尽管天然抗氧化剂被认为比合成紫外线过滤剂更安全，但许多天然抗氧化剂光稳定性差，甚至在紫外线照射下可能转向促氧化活性。目的：评估阿魏酸（FA）的光稳定性和光保护功效，并确定其光转化是否保留保护活性。方法：通过UV-Vis和LC-QTOF-MS分析FA的光转化。在UVA暴露的HaCaT细胞中，使用ROS检测、线粒体功能、DNA损伤标志物、RT-PCR以及FA与Keap1的计算机模拟对接评估光保护效果。结果：在UVA暴露下，FA转化为咖啡酸（CA），但两者均保留了抗氧化潜力。FA减少ROS、稳定线粒体、最小化DNA损伤，并维持正常细胞周期进程。分子分析证实了对接预测的Nrf2-Keap1抗氧化通路激活，以及氧化、炎症和凋亡标志物的抑制。值得注意的是，FA光产物未显示促氧化行为，并保留了其抗氧化活性。结论：本研究展示了一种独特的光转化驱动的稳定性，其中FA转化为CA而不丧失功效。通过结合ROS清除和Nrf2介导的基因调控，FA代表了广谱防晒配方中一种有前景、安全的生物活性剂。
